c74object.name: evi_biquads_extras
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads_extras.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads_extras.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
Additional Biquad code for specific use cases, silently includes a 'DF2' so can be used without dependencies.

entry.name: eviButterworthLp6 ( )
entry.description:
All-in-one Butterworth lowpass 6-pole, by Miller Puckette, created from three [bp~] objects
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
Return 1: Butterworth Lowpass, Filtered audio output

entry.name: hilbertTdf2 ( )
entry.description:
'Transposed Direct Form 2' section, with a1, a2, b1 and b2 factored out as per Hilbert allpass
In 1: type=input: x0,
In 2: type=input: a0, a0 coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Filtered audio output

entry.name: eviHilbertCascade ( )
entry.description:
Hilbert transform 90º phase shifting filter cascade, @see: [evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs] and 'evi_hilbert_coefficients.js', @see: [evi.freqshift.hilbert~] abstraction for an example.
In 1: type=input: y0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: hc1, Polyphase IIR coefficient 1
In 3: type=input: hc2, Polyphase IIR coefficient 2
In 4: type=input: hc3, Polyphase IIR coefficient 3
In 5: type=input: hc4, Polyphase IIR coefficient 4
In 6: type=input: hc5, Polyphase IIR coefficient 5
In 7: type=input: hc6, Polyphase IIR coefficient 6
In 8: type=input: hc7, Polyphase IIR coefficient 7
In 9: type=input: hc8, Polyphase IIR coefficient 8
Return 1: Real, First phase allpass cascade
Return 2: Imag, Second phase allpass cascade

entry.name: eviCascadeCoeffAllpass ( )
entry.description:
Special allpass coefficients (for building evieve digital phaser cascade)
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: Q, Q with specific scaling
In 3: type=param (optional): R, default: 0, Resonance style, R == 1 = Reaktor-ish, R == 0 = MSP-ish
Return 1: a0, a0 coefficient
Return 2: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 3: a2, a2 coefficient

entry.name: biquadDf2cascadeAllpass ( )
entry.description:
'Direct Form 2' but with coefficients reduced rather than repeated for allpass usage, in gen~ cascade form with History()s written out to / read from Data()
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a0, a0 coefficient
In 3: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 5: type=input: x1, State 1 input
In 6: type=input: x2, State 2 input
Return 1: Filter, Filtered audio output
Return 2: x1, State 1 output
Return 3: x2, State 2 output

entry.name: resringzCoeffs ( )
entry.description:
Based on SuperCollider 'resonz()' and 'ringz()' coefficients, flip between 'bandpass_skirt' (bandpass) and 'bandpass_peak' (reson) with the 'filt' parameter
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: QorT60, Q factor or T60 depending on 'filt'
In 3: type=param (optional): filt, default: 0, filt=0 = 'resonz', filt=1 = 'rinqz'
Return 1: a0, a0 coefficient
Return 2: b1, b1 coefficient
Return 3: b2, b2 coefficient

entry.name: firOrder12 ( )
entry.description:
A homeless FIR filter, simultaneous 1st and 2nd order outputs, default coefficients values for lowpass at nyquist
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=param (optional): a0, default: 1, a0 coefficient
In 3: type=param (optional): a1, default: 2, a1 coefficient
In 4: type=param (optional): a2, default: 1, a2 coefficient
Return 1: 1, 1st order output
Return 2: 2, 2nd order output
